name: Pantry Persona
description:
Pantry Persona is a kitchen assistant that keeps track of your food for you.

What it remembers
Everything in your pantry, including expiration dates and which staples are running low. What each person in your household can and can't eat, their food preferences, and the brands they like.

What you can do
• Save recipes from a website or a cooking video, then cook from them step by step
• Plan a week of meals that works for everyone's dietary needs
• Turn that plan into a grocery shopping list, grouped by store, that leaves out what you already have at home
• Send the list to Instacart when you're ready to shop
• Photograph a grocery receipt and the items land in your pantry inventory with prices, quantities, and estimated expiration dates
• Tell it what you cooked and it subtracts the ingredients you used

Share one kitchen
Invite your partner to the same household and you both work from the same information, so a pantry update from either of you shows up for both.

Nutrition
Recipes and meals carry nutrition per person, so you can check calories, protein, or sodium for the whole household or for one picky eater.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pantry Persona to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pantry Persona to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.pantrypersona.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pantry Persona MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pantry Persona lists 20 MCP tools, including find_recipes, get_insights, get_next_steps, get_pantry, get_user_context, manage_collections, manage_meal_plan, manage_pantry, manage_preferences, manage_profiles, manage_recipes, and manage_shopping.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pantry Persona?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pantry Persona in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Pantry Persona MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pantry Persona requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pantry Persona is developed by Pantry Persona. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
